bio.text: Keith Kelley, a Republican, has represented District 12 in the Alabama State Senate since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
According to Ballotpedia, he was born in Anniston, Alabama, and owns and is president of Harris-McKay Realty.
He has served as president of the Alabama Association of Realtors and on the board of directors of the National Association of Realtors.
